purpose: Reserved evaluator for external-evidence generation of a wholly withheld fasting-insulin column; no individual-value matching score.
outcome: natural log of positive insulin in the original documented units
domain: observed predictor rows that have a reference outcome; all observed rows must match the reference exactly by row_id

models.B: log(insulin) ~ centered_BMI/5 + centered_age/10 + sex_indicator; reserved adjusted BMI slope, age and sex secondary questions
models.C: log(insulin) ~ centered_BMI/5 + restricted_cubic_BMI_term + centered_age/10 + sex_indicator; reserved upper-minus-lower BMI slope contrast
models.D: log(insulin) ~ centered_BMI/5 * sex_indicator + centered_age/10; reserved sex difference in BMI slopes

knots: Unweighted visible BMI percentiles 10, 50, 90; exact values frozen before unblinding.
contrast_locations: Unweighted visible BMI percentiles 25, 50, 75; upper-minus-lower secant slope, each expressed per 5 BMI units.
descriptive: Weighted Pearson correlations of BMI with raw insulin and log insulin; no correlation inference.
survey_variance: Taylor linearization using full positive-weight spine; outside-domain PSU scores are zero; stratum-centered PSU score outer products use m/(m-1). No finite-population correction. Singleton strata fail explicitly.
degrees_freedom: number of full-spine PSUs minus strata minus (model rank minus 1); two-sided Student t 95% intervals
synthetic_uncertainty: Survey-conditioned intervals only, not calibrated uncertainty about unmeasured true insulin. Between-draw spread is descriptive and omits model/transport uncertainty unless independently represented in draws. No Rubin pooling.
comparison: Report all prespecified endpoints, true and generated estimates and intervals, signed and absolute differences. No effect-difference tests, equivalence claims, sign constraints, sign-only or significance-only pass, or selection of successful endpoints.
